content:
amanda.partnerships: Heads up — ResellCo onboarding to Azure marketplace is blocked by procurement. Their PO requires an escrow-wiring clause we don't include in standard POs, and legal pushed back on the MSA redline. Can procurement + legal advise next steps?
caroline.procurement: Ack. Do we have the PO snippet they submitted? Need exact wording to check with finance and payments team.
amanda.partnerships: Pasted the relevant lines below from the vendor portal:```PO Line 12: "Buyer shall wire 5% escrow to ResellCo Escrow Agent within 10 business days of PO acceptance"```
caroline.procurement: Ugh. Our treasury team won't accept third-party escrow wiring without a written SLA. Also signer on PO is a regional reseller contact, not the legal entity on file.
sarah.legal: Looking. The MSA redline they submitted adds a disbursement trigger tied to a "mutual acceptance" clause rather than delivery confirmation — that's a liability gap for us. Can we ask them to swap the escrow flow for a holdback on invoice instead?
raj.sales: ResellCo says escrow is a marketplace requirement for certain hardware SKUs from their region — they passed this through the marketplace onboarding checklist. If we push back we'll delay launch by weeks. Can we do a narrow carve-out?
lina-ps: From the marketplace side: Azure validation flagged the escrow as an unsupported payment flow for the PO contract type. Their portal owner suggested an MSA addendum instead of modifying the PO.
mike-ops: If we accept an addendum we need: (1) KYC on the escrow agent, (2) proof of funds routing, (3) legal sign-off on indemnity. Ops won't enable listing until those are cleared.
sarah.legal: Quick path: ask ResellCo to replace the escrow clause with either (A) a 5% invoice holdback tied to acceptance tests, or (B) an escrow addendum executed between Redwood and ResellCo with escrow agent details and indemnity. Option A gets faster momentum.
caroline.procurement: I'll ping finance for holdback feasibility and routing. Tagging @vendor-bot to run a quick entity match on the PO signer vs our vendor registry.
vendor-bot: entity-match report: signer_name="R. Gomez (ResellCo Sales)"; registered_entity="ResellCo, Inc."; EIN mismatch flagged. Recommendation: require signed PO from authorized signer on file or a board resolution.
raj.sales: I'll ask ResellCo to provide a board-signed authorization or switch signer to their finance lead. Also asking if they're open to the invoice holdback alternative.
amanda.partnerships: Timeline sensitivity — marketing planned joint announcement for next Friday. If we need an addendum it'll slip. Can we short-circuit with a conditional listing: publish listing but mark as "pending payments" and disable checkout?
lina-ps: Marketplace policies don't allow live listing with pending payment terms for these SKUs; it's all-or-nothing. We can stage a private listing for early partners but that's limited.
sarah.legal: Pragmatic approach: propose invoice holdback + temporary purchase limit cap in the PO (e.g., limit to $50k) + requirement for authorized signer within 5 business days. That reduces exposure and buys time. Approve on legal side if they accept those terms.
caroline.procurement: Finance OK with holdback + cap pending entity verification. Will need ResellCo to sign an amended PO and provide finance lead contact.
raj.sales: I'll message ResellCo now. ETA from them? 24–48 hours if they cooperate.
mike-ops: Ops can fast-track listing after we have the amended PO and vendor KYC. No infra changes needed.
amanda.partnerships: Great. Action items: (1) Raj -> ask ResellCo to accept invoice holdback + $50k cap and provide authorized signer (due in 48h), (2) Caroline -> confirm holdback flow with finance, (3) Sarah -> prepare a short addendum template if they insist on escrow, (4) Lina -> hold marketplace listing until docs are in. I'll update marketing.
raj.sales: On it. pinging ResellCo now.
amanda.partnerships: Thanks team. I'll follow up in this thread with any vendor replies. :thumbsup:
